mapper.select: /*selectMasterWmGrStockOrderGrRegPopList*/ SELECT PODT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS STDCATLG_ID, PODT.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, PODT.ITEM_QTY AS ITEM_QTY, IVDT.INV_QTY AS GR_QTY, PODT.UNIT_PRICE AS UNIT_PRICE, PODT.UNIT_MEASURE AS UNIT_MEASURE, PODT.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, PODT.MAKER_NAME, 0, PODT.DI_QTY, PODT.ITEM_AMT AS ITEM_AMT, PODT.BUYER, PODT.CONTRACT_NO , PODT.CONTRACT_SEQ, PODT.BYIT_COMORG_CODE FROM ICOMPODT PODT, ICOMIVDT IVDT WHERE PODT.PO_NO = #{PO_NO} AND PODT.BUYER = #{st_warehouse_code} AND IVDT.INV_NO = #{IV_NO} AND PODT.BUYER = IVDT.BUYER AND PODT.PO_NO = IVDT.PO_NO AND PODT.PO_SEQ = IVDT.PO_SEQ AND PODT.STATUS <> 'D' AND IVDT.STATUS <> 'D' ORDER BY PODT.BUYER, PODT.PO_NO, PODT.PO_SEQ
mapper.update: UPDATE ICOMIVDT IVDT SET IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY = NVL(IVDT.INV_QTY,0), IVDT.WMS_GR_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), IVDT.WMS_GR_USER_ID = ? WHERE IVDT.INV_NO = #{IV_NO} AND IVDT.BUYER = #{ware_house_code} AND IVDT.PO_NO = #{PO_NO} AND IVDT.STATUS <> 'D' AND NVL(IVDT.WMS_GR_QTY, 0) = 0
